comparison.objective: Install a bracket, versus release a camera from a cam-clamped mount and place it on a pad.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-feature insertion/latching versus cam release, supported extraction, and careful placement.
comparison.success_condition: Bracket retained at the correct rack level versus cam opened, payload cleared and stably placed without fixture movement or drop.
comparison.reason: One creates a retained structural support; the other releases and removes a payload.
